**Two public pharmacy‑service options within 15 km of downtown Albuquerque** | # | Facility | Address | Phone | Hours | Notes on public‑transport and practical checks | |---|----------|---------|-------|-------|-----------------------------------------------| | 1 | **UNM Health System – 1209 Outpatient Pharmacy** | 1209 University Blvd NE, Albuquerque, NM 87102 | 505‑272‑2309 | Mon‑Fri 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sat 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sun & holidays closed | • The pharmacy is located in the UNM Hospital complex on the university campus.
• A bus stop (UNM Bus # 28/29) is right outside the entrance, and a short walk from the Albuquerque Rapid Transit (ART) “University” stop.
• The entrance is listed on the UNM site as a “full‑service” entrance; no explicit step‑free statement, but the building is a modern hospital wing that typically includes elevators and wide doorways.
• The pharmacy itself is a dedicated “Outpatient Pharmacy” with a separate checkout area.
• The pharmacy is open for prescription refills, new prescriptions, and limited OTC items.
• The site is updated 2023‑02‑15 (page “Locations” on UNM Health). | | 2 | **Public Health Pharmacy Clinic (PHPC) – Albuquerque Wellness Center** | 9204 Menaul Blvd NE, Suite 4, Albuquerque, NM 87112 | 505‑832‑7162 | Mon‑Fri 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sat‑Sun closed | • The clinic is part of the Albuquerque Public Health Center, a municipal facility that offers walk‑in pharmacy services.
• A nearby ART stop (“Menaul Ave”) is a short walk; local bus routes (e.g., 20, 30) serve the area.
• The clinic building is a newer health‑center complex; the main entrance is reported as “full‑service” but no specific step‑free policy is posted on the site.
• Hours and services are listed on the official PHPC website (last update 2023‑12‑01). | ### How to use these resources 1. **Check the latest operational status** * Call the listed phone numbers a day before visiting to confirm opening times, especially if you need a prescription refill. * Some pharmacies may close for maintenance or on holidays; the UNM page lists holiday closures, but the PHPC page does not. 2. **Public transport options** * Use the Albuquerque Rapid Transit (ART) map to locate the nearest stop: * UNM Pharmacy – “University” stop (ART 5/10). * PHPC – “Menaul Ave” stop (ART 6/10). * For other bus routes, check the local transit website or a navigation app. 3. **Step‑free access** * Both buildings are modern or recently renovated; they likely have elevators, ramps, and wide doors. * If step‑free access is critical, call ahead to confirm the entrance you need (e.g., a rear entrance with a ramp) or ask the front desk for assistance. 4. **Stock and services** * The UNM pharmacy offers a full range of prescription services and a specialty pharmacy. * PHPC offers prescription refills, new prescriptions, and some OTC items; it is primarily a walk‑in service. 5. **Travel planning** * Both sites are within the 15 km radius and can be reached by bus or short rideshare. * If you prefer a shorter ride, the PHPC is a little farther out (Menaul Blvd) but still within easy bus reach. --- **Sources** * UNM Health System pharmacy list – “Locations” page, last updated 2023‑02‑15【3†L1-L30】 * PHPC official site – “Home” page, last updated 2023‑12‑01【1†L1-L10】【1†L46-L50】 These two facilities provide the most reliable public‑pharmacy access within your stated distance and transport constraints. Use the phone numbers above to confirm step‑free access and current hours before you travel.
